titleEn: AI Crop Intelligence: From the Leaf to the Bottom Line
titleZh: AI作物智能：从叶片到利润
summaryZh: 本文介绍了Taranis公司在Tech Hub LIVE 2026大会上展示的AI作物智能方案，该方案通过无人机叶片级影像、AI分析、产量影响建模和Ag Assistant工具，帮助农资零售商和种植者检测杂草、病害、虫害、营养缺乏等作物威胁，并量化其对产量的潜在影响，从而辅助农艺师和种植者更快、更自信地做出决策。
featuredReason: 虽然本文聚焦种植业，但其AI+无人机+产量影响建模的技术路径对智慧畜牧行业的从业者具有跨界参考价值，尤其是在利用AI将数据转化为可量化决策方面。
contentFull:
By CropLife 

 

 Share

 

 

 

 

 

 How can AI-powered crop intelligence help ag retailers and growers protect yield and drive stronger ROI? In this Tech Talk at Tech Hub LIVE 2026, Maia Donahue, VP of Product at Taranis, shares how the company combines leaf-level drone imagery, advanced AI analytics, yield impact modeling, and its Ag Assistant to turn field data into actionable recommendations. Learn how Taranis detects weeds, disease, insects, nutrient deficiencies, and other crop threats, then quantifies their potential impact on yield to help agronomists and growers make faster, more confident decisions.
